header.title: Basic Information
header.description: Configure the basic details for your assessment including name, schedule, evaluation method, and result release preferences.

basicInfoSection.description: Name, subject, and instructions shown to participants.

liveDateRangeSection.title: Live Date Range
liveDateRangeSection.description: When participants can start and must finish the assessment.

attemptSettingsSection.title: Attempt Settings
attemptSettingsSection.description: Control how participants take this assessment.

resultEvaluationType.label: Result & Evaluation Type

autoAfterSubmission.label: Auto — Release after submission
autoAfterSubmission.help: System grades automatically. Results are visible to the learner immediately after they submit.

autoAfterAssessmentEnd.label: Auto — Release after exam ends
autoAfterAssessmentEnd.help: System grades automatically. Results become visible only after the assessment end time passes.

noAutoRelease.label: Auto — Release manually
noAutoRelease.help: System grades automatically. Results stay hidden until you click "Release Result" in the submissions tab.

manual.label: Manual evaluation & release
manual.help: Teacher grades each submission by hand. Results stay hidden until you manually evaluate and release them.

resultEvaluationType.managedByApi: Managed by API: results are released by the partner system (or with Release Result), so this stays Manual.

submissionType.label: Submission Type
submissionType.helper: How students submit their answers (e.g., file upload, PDF).

assessmentPreview.description: Let participants preview the assessment before starting.

switchSections.label: Allow {{role}}s to switch between sections
switchSections.description: Participants can jump back and forth between sections.

aiEvaluation.label: Evaluate submissions with AI
aiEvaluation.description: Grade each submission automatically when it is submitted. Uses institute credits per question graded; a teacher still reviews and releases the result.

omrMode.label: OMR sheet (pen & paper) mode
omrMode.description: Students answer on a printed OMR sheet. Only single-correct MCQs (2–5 options, up to 200 questions). Each learner's roll number is their enrollment number. Results stay held until you release them.

durationDistribution.label: Duration Distribution
durationDistribution.helper: Choose whether time limits apply to the whole test, per section, or per question.

reattemptRequest.label: Allow Students to Raise Reattempt Request

timeIncreaseRequest.label: Allow Students to Raise Time Increase Request

validation.cannotSaveGeneric: Can't save yet — some required details are missing or invalid.

proctoring.title: Proctoring
proctoring.description: Watch for cheating during the attempt. Choose how much monitoring this assessment needs; the learner is told before starting.

NONE.label: Off
NONE.description: No camera. Fullscreen and tab-switch checks only.

BASIC.label: Basic
BASIC.description: Webcam check-in, on-device face detection, a small snapshot every few seconds. Nothing streams.

PRO.label: Pro
PRO.description: Basic plus short video clips of each flagged moment and phone detection.

ULTRA.label: Ultra
ULTRA.description: Pro plus a live proctor room and AI review of every attempt.

cameraRequired.label: Camera required to start
cameraRequired.description: The attempt cannot begin until the learner allows the camera.

faceCheck.label: Face detection
faceCheck.description: Flag when no face, or more than one face, is in frame. Runs on the learner's device.

showSelfView.label: Show learner their camera
showSelfView.description: A small preview stays on screen so they know they are being recorded.

snapshotInterval.label: Snapshot every
snapshotInterval.description: Routine frames for review. Flags always capture one.

maxViolations.label: Auto-submit after
maxViolations.description: Flags before the attempt is submitted automatically. Never = only record for review.
